history.subject: Rigid engine, RE-0+RE-2: the localized-module bridge and the Nakayama/openness exports, both Noetherian-free. RE-0 — the QcohOn packaging meets mathlib's IsLocalizedModule term-for-term: the ambient-ring module structures and linear restriction maps on any quasi-coherent sheaf's sections, and THE BRIDGE — restriction to U ⊓ D(g) is the localization at the powers of g (surjectivity from the extension-after-scaling axiom, injectivity-up-to-powers from the killing axiom, unit action as the datum), with the structure-sheaf specialization unconditional since g is a unit on its basic open. RE-2 — for any finite module: vanishing of every residue-field fiber forces vanishing (Nakayama through the support), the fiber-vanishing locus IS the support complement, hence OPEN — the openness-of-the-vanishing-locus export the datum's strata bookkeeping consumes; stated for general finite modules (the concurrency-forced decoupling that is also the right generality — the H¹ instantiations are one-liners downstream). Rigid engine, RE-3: the rigidity clauses with module coefficients, as reusable module algebra about an arbitrary linear map (schemes enter only at the RE-4 instantiation δ = the two-lattice pair map). Vanishing H¹ makes δ surjective; the cokernel base-changes to zero by right-exactness; and for flat codomain the KERNEL commutes with ⊗ — H⁰ ⊗ P ≅ ker(δ ⊗ P) for every module P and the on-the-nose base-change equivalence over every ring map — the clause that makes Q = H⁰ rigid. Flatness and (Noetherian + finite) projectivity of the kernel by the split route with projective codomain (the worksheet's own section construction — the honest hypothesis, free in the application). Plus the duality file: the finite-PROJECTIVE upgrade of the dual-tensor-hom equivalence (mathlib has only finite-free; the retract argument) giving Kleiman's eq:Q bookkeeping H⁰ ⊗ P ≅ Hom(H⁰^∨, P). Cohomology/RigidEngine3Rigidity.lean, RigidEngine3Duality.lean; root build 8727 jobs, nine keystones independently verified axiom-clean
